name: Asha
source:
A dangerous enforcer in the employ of dark powers, it is her job to eliminate enemies. She has always had a fascination with the Almighty's Chosen, despite the fact that they're supposed to be her enemies.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
